The `sha256sums` entry of `SKIP` for the git source is a normal integrity-trust consideration for a pinned-tag VCS source, and in any case no sources are downloaded or verified during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. It does not affect the safety of this command.
</details>
<evidence>

No network operations, code execution, obfuscation, or data exfiltration is present. The operations are limited to system configuration necessary for the service to run, consistent with standard service packaging in Arch Linux. The behavior aligns with upstream packaging norms (e.g., rpm/deb) by preserving configuration on removal.
